notes: The first visitor to /admin/setup creates the administrator. Complete setup immediately after deployment; the panel does not claim the administrator or configure SMTP.

The upstream self-host-predeploy.js prepares the persistent signing key and runs Prisma and data migrations before the official node ./dist/main.js server command. It runs on each start instead of using a restartable one-shot migration service.
AFFINE_SERVER_EXTERNAL_URL follows the application's public URL. The indexer is disabled to reduce memory use; indexed search features are therefore unavailable.

Storage, the signing-key configuration directory and PostgreSQL use separate external named volumes; Redis holds only cache and queue data and has no volume, as upstream. Only AFFiNE publishes a loopback port; PostgreSQL uses a generated password instead of upstream trust authentication.

The 2g application floor is provisional pending dual-OS live memory measurements. Exact release images were verified for linux/amd64; tested lists remain empty until Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04 live verification.
